svg.title: Protected request authentication, assurance, and authorization flow
svg.desc: The transport validates one credential source, checks CSRF for unsafe cookie requests, and enforces the route assurance requirement to establish an immutable principal. The application then evaluates a stable action and exact resource against current PostgreSQL state and durably records allow or deny. Every failed or unavailable gate stops the request.
